## Verification

- [ ] `npm run quality`
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` and `npm run security:sast` for UI/security changes
- [ ] Visual review for UI changes; full UI audits when certifying a milestone
- [ ] PLAN.md reviewed; remaining gates and the next slice recorded honestly

List executed checks and their results. Identify any unexecuted or failing gate;
an unchecked box is not a pass.
